cards.title: DTE Vantage | J.P. Morgan AM
cards.metadata: J.P. Morgan AM (Buyout) · Distributed Energy & Renewables · United States
cards.description: Institutional investors advised by J.P. Morgan AM’s Global Infrastructure group agreed to acquire DTE Energy’s non-utility Vantage business for ~US$3bn. The sale includes renewable gas recovery, wholesale power and renewables, and on-site energy projects. DTE is retaining its coke operations.
cards.scaleNote: ~US$3bn purchase price, subject to customary adjustments

cards.title: Harvestone Low Carbon Partners | ECP
cards.description: ECP agreed to sell Harvestone Low Carbon Partners to The Andersons for US$915mm. Its three ethanol plants in North Dakota and Indiana can produce ~215mm gallons annually, and the Blue Flint facility operates a carbon capture and storage system.
cards.scaleNote: US$915mm enterprise value for three ethanol plants and related operations

cards.title: Aypa Power | NBIM / Brookfield
cards.metadata: NBIM / Brookfield (Co-Investment) · Battery Storage · United States & Canada
cards.description: NBIM disclosed a US$300mm direct investment for 10% of Aypa Power alongside Brookfield. The investment is separate from NBIM’s existing indirect exposure through Brookfield’s Global Transition Fund. Aypa has ~6.5GW of battery storage in operation, under construction or under contract.
cards.scaleNote: US$300mm for NBIM’s direct 10% equity interest

cards.title: Puna Geothermal | Northleaf
cards.description: Ormat disclosed a definitive agreement to buy Northleaf’s remaining interest in Hawaii’s Puna Geothermal plant for up to US$59.5mm, including a US$21.1mm payment tied to a repowering milestone. Ormat will own 100% of the plant at closing.
cards.scaleNote: US$59.5mm aggregate purchase price including a milestone payment

cards.title: 892MW U.S. Cogeneration Portfolio | ECP / Fengate
cards.metadata: ECP / Fengate (Buyout) · Gas-Fired Cogeneration · United States
cards.description: ECP acquired three gas-fired cogeneration plants totaling 892MW from Fengate. The facilities in Texas and Illinois supply steam and electricity to two petrochemical complexes under long-term contracts.
cards.scaleNote: 892MW across three operating cogeneration plants in Texas and Illinois

cards.title: Vizag Mega Data Center Park | Sixth Street
cards.metadata: Sixth Street (Bolt-On) · Data Center Development · India
cards.description: AdaniConneX, the joint venture between Adani Enterprises and Sixth Street-backed EdgeConneX, signed an agreement to buy Vizag Mega Data Center Park for ~INR10.86bn. The pre-operating company holds land and licenses for infrastructure development in Visakhapatnam.
cards.scaleNote: ~INR10.86bn cash consideration for 100% of the company

cards.title: Speedcast Teleport Infrastructure | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure (Bolt-On) · Satellite Ground Infrastructure · Global
cards.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed SatPort acquired Speedcast’s network of 12 teleports across 11 countries. The acquisition expands SatPort’s carrier-neutral satellite ground network across five continents, and Speedcast will continue using the sites under a long-term services agreement.
cards.scaleNote: 12 teleports in 11 countries across five continents

cards.title: Ubiquity | Generate Capital
cards.metadata: Generate Capital (Sale) · Fiber Networks · United States
cards.description: 1248 Holdings and affiliates acquired Generate Capital’s ownership interests in Ubiquity, whose fiber networks pass more than 200,000 addresses across Texas and Nebraska. The founding investor plans to provide additional capital to expand the network and FiberFirst internet service.
cards.scaleNote: More than 200,000 addresses passed across Texas and Nebraska

cards.title: Constellation Aviation | I Squared / ADIA
cards.metadata: I Squared / ADIA (Joint Venture) · Aircraft Leasing · Global
cards.description: I Squared and ADIA agreed to form an aircraft leasing venture with Avolon, which will retain a minority stake and manage the fleet. The platform is expected to buy 22 aircraft valued at US$1.4bn from Avolon, with leases to 17 airlines across 15 countries.
cards.scaleNote: US$1.4bn market value of the 22 aircraft expected to seed the venture

cards.title: University of Kansas Gateway District Student Housing | Axium
cards.target: University of Kansas Gateway District Student Housing
cards.metadata: Axium (Majority Stake) · Student Housing P3 · United States
cards.description: An Axium-managed fund agreed to acquire 95% of a 482-bed student housing project under construction in Lawrence, Kansas. The two buildings are being developed under a 99-year air rights lease and are expected to open for the 2028–29 academic year.
cards.scaleNote: 482 beds across two student housing buildings under construction

decisions.evidence: DTE publicly disclosed the signed non-utility Vantage sale on November 5. Its same-day SEC 8-K reports November 1 signing and the base equity purchase price. This is unrelated to Vantage Data Centers.

decisions.evidence: The February 27 IMDA publication disclosed the September 14, 2025 signed agreement and describes the wider teleport divestiture. EQT's November 3 release reports completion of the global carve-out. Proposed tracker date is February 27, with a November briefing link as completion coverage. North America is the proposed region proxy based on the Delaware acquirer and U.S. seller, with Global shown as the footprint.

data.title: Speedcast Teleport Infrastructure | EQT Infrastructure
data.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed SatPort acquired Speedcast’s network of 12 teleports across 11 countries. The acquisition expands SatPort’s carrier-neutral satellite ground network across five continents, and Speedcast will continue using the sites under a long-term services agreement. Singapore’s regulator published details of the signed agreement on February 27, 2026. EQT reported completion on November 3.
keyHighlights: 12 teleports in 11 countries across five continents
data.assetScale: 12 teleports across 11 countries and five continents

decisions.evidence: 1248 disclosed the completed acquisition of Generate's entire interest on November 2, without publishing the percentage or terms. The existing July tracker row is a separate regional network asset sale.
